title.zh: Clarity Act's odds of passing plunge as Republicans reject Democrats' counter-proposal
title.en: Clarity Act's odds of passing plunge as Republicans reject Democrats' counter-proposal

current_state.zh: The Clarity Act's odds of passing this year fell to roughly 14% on Polymarket after Senate Republicans rejected Democrats' counterproposal hours before a key procedural vote, stalling the crypto market-structure bill.
